default.description: Default permissions for arkiv. NOTE the `remote` block: this app does not load bundled app:// content — main.rs points the webview at the Python backend on http://127.0.0.1:<negotiated port>, which Tauri's ACL classifies as a REMOTE origin. A capability without `remote` covers local app URLs only (tauri-utils acl::capability: `remote` defaults to unset because 'our default use case is that the content is served from our local application'), so every command was denied for this webview with 'not allowed by ACL' — the API objects were still injected, which is why it looked like a dead button rather than a permissions problem. The port is chosen at runtime by free_port(), so the pattern has to accept any port.
